newsitem.title: FRANCE: SIDO raises French 1996 sunflower crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: SIDO raises French 1996 sunflower crop estimate.

text.p: The French oilseeds and protein seeds association SIDO on Wednesday raised its estimate for the 1996 sunflower crop to 1.92 million tonnes from a June target of 1.8 million and 1.9 million produced in 1995.
In its September report SIDO said a prolonged drought in the spring had a less severe impact on production than initially thought.
The new estimate assumed a yield of 2.1 tonnes per hectare against two tonnes forecast in June and 1.95 tonnes achieved last year.
Sowing areas were seen falling by some seven percent to 910,000 hectares from 975,000.
In June SIDO put 1996 sowings at 906,000 hectares.
Sunflower seed imports from eastern Europe were expected to continue, leading to total imports of 270,000 tonnes against 213,000 tonnes in 1995/96.
An expected decline in European rapeseed crushings and lower sunflower seeds prices may lift exports of French rapeseed to the rest of the European Union to 570,000 tonnes from 462,000 tonnes.
Carry-over stocks were expected to be 276,000 tonnes at end-June 1997, unchanged from the previous year.
